admin.authTagline: Run your gym from your phone. No monthly fees.
admin.backupHint: Download all your data as one file, or restore it on a new server.
admin.chatNotFound: No chat yet — open your bot in Telegram and press Start first.
admin.importConfirm: This replaces all your members, plans and settings. Continue?
admin.invalidBackup: That file isn't a valid Nadi backup
admin.invalidSetupCode: Wrong setup code — check your server logs
admin.invalidToken: That doesn’t look like a bot token
admin.loginSub: Enter your password to manage your gym
admin.notifyHint: Get a message on your phone the moment something new arrives — free, through your own Telegram bot.
admin.notifyStep1: In Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot and copy the token it gives you.
admin.notifyStep2: Paste the token below, then open your new bot and press Start.
admin.notifyStep3: Press “Find my chat”, then send a test.
admin.policyPh: e.g. Bring a towel. Scan your card at every visit.
admin.previewHint: Changes show here instantly. Press Save to publish them.
admin.rateLimited: Too many attempts, please wait a bit
admin.sampleData: Start with sample plans and classes
admin.sampleHint: You can edit or delete them later
admin.setupCodeHint: For your security: find this code in your server logs (the line starting with “Setup code”), or set the SETUP_CODE environment variable.
admin.setupSub: One minute and you can add members and check them in.
admin.shareSub: Put it in your Instagram bio, on WhatsApp and on a QR poster at the reception.
admin.shareText: See our plans and class timetable at {name} 👇
admin.testFailed: Couldn’t send — check the token and chat ID
admin.testMessage: If you can read this, notifications are working 🎉
admin.themeDesc_bold: Loud colours and thick outlines. Impossible to miss.
admin.themeDesc_elegant: Dark and classy, for premium studios.
admin.themeDesc_fresh: Clean and bright. Works for everything.
admin.themeDesc_soft: Pastel and rounded — lovely for salons and spas.
admin.tokenSaved: Saved ({hint}) — paste a new one to replace it
admin.weakPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters
admin.authPoint1: Members check in by scanning their phone at the door
admin.authPoint2: Plans, freezes, payments and renewals in one place
admin.authPoint3: WhatsApp renewal reminders in one tap
admin.tip1: Put the QR poster at the reception and on the mirror — people join from it.
admin.tip2: Send renewal reminders a week before plans end: most people renew right away.
admin.tip3: Message lapsed members with a small comeback offer.
admin.tip4: Put a tablet at the door with the kiosk link so members check themselves in.
admin.renewalsHint: Plans ending this week. One tap sends a ready-made WhatsApp reminder.
admin.noRenewals: Nobody needs to renew this week 🎉
admin.winBackHint: Plans that ended this month and weren't renewed.
admin.kioskHint: Open this secret link on a tablet at the entrance. Members scan the QR on their phone card and get in.
admin.kioskStep1: Open the link on a tablet or old phone and allow the camera.
admin.kioskStep2: Mount it at the entrance, screen facing members.
admin.kioskStep3: Members open their card link and hold the QR to the camera.
admin.kioskResetConfirm: The old kiosk link will stop working. Continue?
admin.cameraError: Camera unavailable. Allow camera access (the page must use HTTPS).
admin.alreadyCheckedIn: Already checked in a moment ago
admin.noMembers: No members yet. Add your first one!
admin.sendCardHint: Send the member their card link. They show its QR at the door.
admin.addPlansFirst: Tip: add your plans first (Plans tab) so you can sell them.
admin.renewStartsHint: Leave empty to start right after the current plan ({date}).
admin.deleteMemberConfirm: Delete {name} with all their plans, payments and visits?
admin.cancelPlanConfirm: Cancel this plan? It stays in the history.
admin.freezeHint: Pause the plan (travel, injury). The end date moves back by the same number of days.
admin.noPlans: No plans yet. Add your memberships and class packs.
admin.timetableHint: Shown on your gym page. Leave it empty if you don't run classes.
admin.visitsLimitHint: 0 = unlimited. e.g. 12 sessions within the time below.
admin.deletePlanConfirm: Delete this plan? Members who already have it keep it.
admin.showPrices: Show prices on the gym page
admin.graceDaysHint: Let members in for a few days after their plan ends (with a reminder).
